name: SandBase
summary: Hosted one-key API for models, data APIs, agent sandboxes and MCP, with pay-per-call billing and a free catalog/discovery surface.
description: Commercial platform from AXIOMCLOUD PTE. LTD. (Singapore). Free docs verified 2026-11-10: llms.txt, OpenAPI (https://www.sandbase.ai/openapi.json), SKILL.md, pricing and terms. API base https://api.sandbase.ai/v1 (OpenAI-compatible chat, /v1/run for media, /v1/api/... for data). MCP initialize 200 at https://mcp.sandbase.ai/mcp and https://www.sandbase.ai/mcp (serverInfo sandbase, version scheduled-50baf10) without a key. Pricing page: pay per call, no subscription; catalog/schema/price reads are $0; 100 free calls/day on eligible data APIs (resets 00:00 UTC); sandboxes free for now with fair-use caps and pricing to be announced before a change; failed calls are not charged; some models show live discounts (up to 35%). Live price cards are authoritative. API key required for billed calls (not created during verification). Sandboxes and agents can execute code and call external services with permissions you supply — treat as potentially destructive. Hosted service terms are proprietary; companion GitHub repos sandbaseai/sandbase, sandbase-harness and sandbase-skills are Apache-2.0. Vendor-affiliated listing request (#29, david@sandbase.ai). Same operator family as sandbase-harness and sandbase-skills.

agent_access.notes: Catalog, docs, OpenAPI and MCP initialize need no key. Billed model/data-API calls require a SandBase API key (not created during verification).
